mn45:3.1: Katamañ-ca bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhaṃ āyatiṃ dukkhavipākaṃ:
mn45:3.2: Santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn45:3.7: Kiṃ su nāma te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāmesu anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā kāmānaṃ pahānam-āhaṃsu kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpenti;
mn45:3.8: sukho imissā paribbājikāya taruṇāya mudukāya lomasāya bāhāya samphasso ti te kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjanti.
mn45:3.9: Te kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjitvā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
mn45:3.10: Te tattha dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn45:3.12: Idaṃ kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāmesu anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā kāmānaṃ pahānam-āhaṃsu kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpenti, ime hi mayaṃ kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyāmāti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn45:4.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave gimhānaṃ pacchime māse māluvāsipāṭikā phaleyya,
mn45:4.2: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave māluvābījaṃ aññatarasmiṃ sālamūle nipateyya.
mn45:4.3: Atha kho bhikkhave yā tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthā devatā sā bhītā saṃviggā santāsaṃ āpajjeyya.
mn45:4.4: Atha kho bhikkhave tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā, osadhitiṇavanaspatisu adhivatthā devatā, saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāseyyuṃ:
mn45:4.5: Mā bhavaṃ bhāyi. mā bhavaṃ bhāyi,
mn45:4.6: app-eva nām' etaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya mago vā khādeyya davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ upacikā vā udrabheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā pan' assāti.
mn45:4.7: Atha kho taṃ bhikkhave māluvābījaṃ n' eva moro gileyya na mago khādeyya na davaḍāho ḍaheyya na vanakammikā uddhareyyuṃ na upacikā udrabheyyuṃ, bījaṃ pan' assa. Taṃ pāvussakena meghena abhippavaṭṭaṃ samma-d-eva virūheyya,
mn45:4.8: sā 'ssa māluvālatā taruṇā mudukā lomasā vilambinī, sā taṃ sālaṃ upaniseveyya.
mn45:4.9: Atha kho bhikkhave tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya evam-assa:
mn45:4.10: Kiṃ su nāma te bhonto mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā, osadhitiṇavanaspatisu adhivatthā devatā, māluvābīje anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāsesuṃ:
mn45:4.11: mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi,
mn45:4.12: app-eva nām' etaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya mago vā khādeyya davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ upacikā vā udrabheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā pan' assāti;
mn45:4.13: sukho imissā māluvālatāya taruṇāya mudukāya lomasāya vilambiniyā samphasso ti.
mn45:4.15: sā taṃ sālaṃ anupariharitvā upari viṭabhiṃ kareyya,
mn45:4.17: oghanaṃ janetvā ye tassa sālassa mahantā mahantā khandhā te padāleyya.
mn45:4.18: Atha kho bhikkhave tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya evam-assa:
mn45:4.19: Idaṃ kho te bhonto mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā, osadhitiṇavanaspatisu adhivatthā devatā, māluvābīje anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāsesuṃ:
mn45:4.20: mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, app-eva nām' etaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya mago vā khādeyya davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ upacikā vā udrabheyyuṃ , \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ abījaṃ vā pan' assāti,
mn45:4.21: yañ-cāhaṃ māluvābījahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyāmīti.
mn45:4.22: Evam-eva kho bhikkhave santi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino: na-tthi kāmesu doso ti.

mn45:4.27: sukho imissā paribbājikāya taruṇāya mudukāya lomasāya bāhāya samphasso ti
mn45:4.29: Te kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
mn45:4.30: Te tattha dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn45:4.32: Idaṃ kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāmesu anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā kāmānaṃ pahānam-āhaṃsu kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpenti,

mn45:4.34: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhaṃ āyatiṃ dukkhavipākaṃ.
mn45:5.1: Katamañ-ca bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañ-c' eva āyatiñ-ca dukkhavipākaṃ:
mn45:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco acelako hoti muttācāro hatthāpalekhano, na ehibhadantiko na tiṭṭhabhadantiko, na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissakaṭaṃ na nimantaṇaṃ sādiyati;
mn45:5.3: so na kumbhīmukhā patigaṇhāti na kaḷopimukhā patigaṇhāti, na eḷakamantaraṃ na daṇḍamantaraṃ na musalamantaraṃ, na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na purisantaragatāya, na saṅkittisu, na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thusodakaṃ pibati.
mn45:5.4: So ekāgāriko vā hoti ekālopiko, dvāgāriko vā hoti dvālopiko -- sattāgāriko vā hoti sattālopiko;
mn45:5.5: ekissā pi dattiyā yāpeti, dvīhi pi dattīhi yāpeti -- sattahi pi dattīhi yāpeti;
mn45:5.6: ekāhikam-pi āhāraṃ āhāreti, dvīhikam-pi āhāraṃ āhāreti -- sattāhikam-pi āhāraṃ āhāreti, iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam-pi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogam-anuyutto viharati.
mn45:5.7: So sākabhakkho vā hoti sāmākabhakkho vā hoti nīvārabhakkho vā hoti daddulabhakkho vā hoti haṭabhakkho vā hoti kaṇabhakkho vā hoti ācāmabhakkho vā hoti piññākabhakkho vā hoti tiṇabhakkho vā hoti gomayabhakkho vā hoti, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.
mn45:5.8: So sāṇāni pi dhāreti masāṇāni pi dhāreti chavadussāni pi dhāreti paṃsukūlāni pi dhāreti tirīṭāni pi dhāreti ajināni pi dhāreti ajinakkhipam-pi dhāreti kusacīram-pi dhāreti vākacīram-pi dhāreti phalakacīram-pi dhāreti kesakambalam-pi dhāreti vālakambalam-pi dhāreti ulūkapakkham-pi dhāreti;
mn45:5.12: kaṇṭakāpassayiko pi hoti kaṇṭakāpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti,
mn45:5.14: Iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogam-anuyutto viharati.
mn45:5.15: So kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
mn45:5.16: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañ-c' eva āyatiñ-ca dukkhavipākaṃ.
mn45:6.1: Katamañ-ca bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccupannadukkhaṃ āyatiṃ sukhavipākaṃ:
mn45:6.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pakatiyā tibbarāgajātiko hoti, so abhikkhaṇaṃ rāgajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti;
mn45:6.3: pakatiyā tibbadosajātiko hoti, so abhikkhaṇaṃ dosajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti;
mn45:6.4: pakatiyā tibbamohajātiko hoti, so abhikkhaṇaṃ mohajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn45:6.5: So sahāpi dukkhena sahāpi domanassena assumukho pi rudamāno paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati.
mn45:6.6: So kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn45:6.7: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhaṃ āyatiṃ sukhavipākaṃ.
mn45:7.1: Katamañ-ca bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañ-c' eva āyatiñ-ca sukhavipākaṃ:
mn45:7.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pakatiyā na tibbarāgajātiko hoti, so na abhikkhaṇaṃ rāgajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti;
mn45:7.3: pakatiyā na tibbadosajātiko hoti, so na abhikkhaṇaṃ dosajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti;
mn45:7.4: pakatiyā na tibbamohajātiko hoti, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ so na abhikkhaṇaṃ mohajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn45:7.5: So vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn45:7.6: Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañ-ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yan-taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekhako satimā sukhavihārī ti
mn45:7.7: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ
mn45:7.9: So kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn45:7.10: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañ-c' eva āyatiñ-ca sukhavipākaṃ.
